verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a rendered OpenAPI 3.0 reference at api.secureframe.com/docs. It covers resource-oriented REST endpoints, every tagged endpoint group opens with request/response schemas, and the full spec is embedded in the page. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, so only the reference half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: try-it/runnable request console, code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
